final_message:
I fixed it in `src/wrap.py`. `wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7)` now returns `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`.

The line-break check was off by one. It started a new line when the length would exceed `width - 1`, so a line of exactly `width` characters was never allowed. I changed the check to `> width`.

All 5 tests in `tests/test_wrap.py` pass, including the exact-width case from your report.
